latest_release.name: OhMyGame v0.0.0-beta.5.7
latest_release.body:
### Added

- Play Web Games online with friends: the agent sets up turn-based or realtime
  rooms, and players' sign-in, cloud saves and leaderboards, on OhMyGame's game
  service, so publishing needs no server of your own.
  ([#759](https://github.com/WhiteTowerAI/ohmygame/pull/759) by @xinyang6879)
- Browse plugins as in an app store: Discover with categories, recommended
  order, and a page for each plugin with screenshots and details; Installed
  with updates first; and Mine for the plugins you make with AI.
  ([#769](https://github.com/WhiteTowerAI/ohmygame/pull/769) by @dogxii)
- Check pixel art in Image tools: logical size, colours, stray pixels, outline
  and feet row, and whether several sprites match.
  ([#774](https://github.com/WhiteTowerAI/ohmygame/pull/774) by @xinyang6879)
- Add a Japanese README.
  ([#753](https://github.com/WhiteTowerAI/ohmygame/pull/753) by @eltociear)

### Changed

- Give each plugin one switch: adding a plugin or turning it on allows what it
  asks for, with no second approval, and projects can still turn it off for
  themselves. Plugins that use newer manifest fields still install, and a new
  version removes older ones no project uses.
  ([#769](https://github.com/WhiteTowerAI/ohmygame/pull/769) by @dogxii)
- Fix pixel art finds the real pixel grid, even when its cells are uneven, so
  generated pixel art no longer comes out as a mosaic.
  ([#774](https://github.com/WhiteTowerAI/ohmygame/pull/774) by @xinyang6879)
- Shorten the README to a landing page that links to the website's docs.
  ([#757](https://github.com/WhiteTowerAI/ohmygame/pull/757) by @dogxii)

### Fixed

- Find coding agents that npm installed, such as Gemini CLI, on Windows.
  ([#769](https://github.com/WhiteTowerAI/ohmygame/pull/769) by @dogxii)
- Title successful Canvas actions, such as Created and Downloaded, as results
  rather than failures.
  ([#774](https://github.com/WhiteTowerAI/ohmygame/pull/774) by @xinyang6879)
- Say when a copy button could not copy to the clipboard.
  ([#738](https://github.com/WhiteTowerAI/ohmygame/pull/738) by @jay23606)

detail.readme:
The open-source studio for making games with AI.

English | 简体中文 | 日本語

Website · Docs · Community games · Changelog

Describe a game, and the agent designs it, makes the art, writes the code, plays it to check it works, and publishes it to a link anyone can open. Design docs, images, video, 3D, and audio live on one canvas next to the code, instead of across five different apps. > [!NOTE] > OhMyGame is in beta. Expect rough edges, and tell us what breaks. ## Download | Platform | Download | | --------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | | macOS (Apple silicon) | [OhMyGame for Mac](https://ohmygame.ai/download/mac) | | Windows (x64) | [OhMyGame for Windows](https://ohmygame.ai/download/windows) | Older builds and release notes are on [Releases](https://github.com/WhiteTowerAI/ohmygame/releases). The Windows build isn't code-signed yet, so SmartScreen may warn on first install. Intel Mac and Linux are [on the roadmap](https://github.com/WhiteTowerAI/ohmygame/issues). OhMyGame ships without a model. On first launch, connect a provider or a coding agent you already use: [first run](https://ohmygame.ai/docs/first-run/). ## Features - **Let the agent build the game.** The agent drafts the design doc, writes the code, runs the game in a live preview, then plays it and tries a fix when something breaks. - **One canvas for every asset.** Generate images, video, 3D models, animation, voices, sound effects, and music with AI, and keep them organized on one canvas, ready to use in your game. - **Publish to a link.** Anyone can play it in the browser, and it shows up in the [Community](https://ohmygame.ai/community/). A multiplayer game's rooms, and its players' sign-in, saves, and leaderboards, come with it. - **Extend it with plugins.** A plugin can teach the agent new skills, give it new tools, and add panels and project types to the app. Bundled plugins cover Godot, Unity, Unreal Engine, Blender, Aseprite, Tiled, and platforms like WeChat and Douyin Mini Games. Or [make your own](https://ohmygame.ai/docs/plugins/make/). - **Bring your own agent.** Run OhMyGame on Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode, or on any of 40+ model providers with your own keys. No per-run credits. It works the other way too: use the canvas, media generation, and playtesting from your agent over MCP. [Models](https://ohmygame.ai/docs/models/) · [External agents](docs/external-agents.md) ## What you can make Three games our team made with OhMyGame:
Interactive film Island builder Deckbuilding roguelike
**Web games** (Phaser, Three.js, React Three Fiber) are the best place to start. **Interactive stories** cover visual novels, interactive films, and story games. **General games** work with any engine or stack. Web games can be **multiplayer**, from board and card games to realtime arenas, played online with friends with no server of your own. See [Multiplayer](docs/multiplayer.md). [Play what others made](https://ohmygame.ai/community/). ## Documentation Guides for using OhMyGame are at **[ohmygame.ai/docs](https://ohmygame.ai/docs/)**: [install](https://ohmygame.ai/docs/install/), [first run](https://ohmygame.ai/docs/first-run/), [models](https://ohmygame.ai/docs/models/), and [plugins](https://ohmygame.ai/docs/plugins/). Technical references live in this repo under [`docs/`](docs/README.md), such as the [runtime](docs/runtime.md), [coding agents](docs/coding-agents.md), [custom models](docs/custom-models.md), and the [plugin contract](docs/plugins.md). ## Build from source Requires [Bun](https://bun.sh) 1.4.2+ and Node.js 22.19+. ```bash git clone https://github.com/WhiteTowerAI/ohmygame.git cd ohmygame bun install --frozen-lockfile bun run dev # web renderer + local daemon bun run dev:desktop # or the Electron app ``` Builds from source send no telemetry. For branches, checks, and optional cloud setup, see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). ## Privacy Your projects and API keys stay on your machine, and prompts go straight to the providers you choose. You only need an account to publish. Release builds send usage data and crash reports, which you can turn off in **Settings → About**. See [logs and diagnostics](docs/diagnostics.md). ## Contributing Issues and pull requests are welcome. Branch from `dev` and open PRs against `dev`; `main` holds releases. Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md), pick up a [`help wanted`](https://github.com/WhiteTowerAI/ohmygame/labels/help%20wanted) issue, and report security problems privately through [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). ## Community [Discord](https://discord.gg/TkrgvGQ2Zc) · [QQ group 460706923](https://qun.qq.com/universal-share/share?ac=1&authKey=65LzSf96ttluVSAPzPKJvrsoQ0NSQHPJnhgJImnnqIik9uK64ljVd%2FzkRWb8Xanz&busi_data=eyJncm91cENvZGUiOiI0NjA3MDY5MjMiLCJ0b2tlbiI6InNUNWR3U05OeVlMZEVCK0YxNUNKckplazliYklGRnV6ZUZGM1NlV29vYVdKNGkrR2g2c28zNG1kdDFFcHllczMiLCJ1aW4iOiIyNDUxMjQwODEifQ%3D%3D&data=CQ5T4W2Ac1NWWg56dH_HQwixT7faVMm5Xq5kZsLgx9TDBGxeqs3mwXNLVUpO83oOUobc1qXBosRKYmWnziWboA&svctype=4&tempid=h5_group_info) · [Issues](https://github.com/WhiteTowerAI/ohmygame/issues) ## Star History ## License [Apache-2.0](LICENSE). The OhMyGame name and logo are not covered by the license.
detail.readme_zh:
用 AI 做游戏的开源工作室。

English | 简体中文 | 日本語

官网 · 文档 · 社区游戏 · 更新日志

描述你想做的游戏，Agent 会写设计文档、做美术、写代码，亲自试玩确认能跑通，再发布成一个谁都能打开的链接。设计文档、图片、视频、3D 和音频都和代码放在同一块画布上，不用在五六个工具之间来回切换。 > [!NOTE] > OhMyGame 目前处于 Beta 阶段，难免有粗糙的地方。遇到问题欢迎告诉我们。 ## 下载 | 平台 | 下载 | | --------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | | macOS（Apple 芯片） | [下载 Mac 版](https://ohmygame.ai/download/mac) | | Windows（x64） | [下载 Windows 版](https://ohmygame.ai/download/windows) | 历史版本和更新说明见 [Releases](https://github.com/WhiteTowerAI/ohmygame/releases)。Windows 版暂未做代码签名，首次安装时可能会弹出 SmartScreen 警告。Intel Mac 和 Linux 版本已在[计划中](https://github.com/WhiteTowerAI/ohmygame/issues)。 OhMyGame 不内置模型。首次启动时，连接一个模型服务商，或者选择你已经在用的编程 Agent：见[首次运行](https://ohmygame.ai/docs/first-run/)。 ## 功能 - **让 Agent 来做游戏。** Agent 起草设计文档、编写代码、在实时预览里运行游戏，然后亲自上手玩，发现问题就尝试修复。 - **所有素材在一块画布上。** 用 AI 生成图片、视频、3D 模型、动画、配音、音效和音乐，在同一块画布上整理，直接用进游戏。 - **发布成一个链接。** 任何人都能在浏览器里玩，游戏也会出现在[社区](https://ohmygame.ai/zh/community/)里。多人游戏的房间，以及玩家的登录、存档和排行榜，也会一起上线。 - **用插件扩展。** 插件可以教 Agent 新技能、给它新工具，也可以给应用添加面板和项目类型。内置插件已覆盖 Godot、Unity、Unreal Engine、Blender、Aseprite、Tiled，以及微信小游戏、抖音小游戏等平台。也可以[自己做插件](https://ohmygame.ai/docs/plugins/make/)。 - **自带 Agent。** 用 Claude Code、Codex 或 OpenCode 来驱动 OhMyGame，也可以接入 40 多家模型服务商，用你自己的密钥。不按次收费。反过来也行：通过 MCP，在你的 Agent 里使用 OhMyGame 的画布、媒体生成和试玩能力。[模型](https://ohmygame.ai/docs/models/) · [外部 Agent](docs/external-agents.md) ## 你可以做什么 我们团队用 OhMyGame 做的三款游戏：
互动电影 岛屿建造 卡牌构筑 Roguelike
**网页游戏**（Phaser、Three.js、React Three Fiber）最适合入门。**互动故事**适合做视觉小说、互动电影和剧情游戏。**General Game** 不限引擎和技术栈。网页游戏可以做成**多人联机**，从棋牌到实时对战，和朋友在线一起玩，不用自己架服务器，详见[多人联机](docs/multiplayer.md)。[去玩玩别人做的游戏](https://ohmygame.ai/zh/community/)。 ## 文档 使用指南在 **[ohmygame.ai/docs](https://ohmygame.ai/docs/)**：[安装](https://ohmygame.ai/docs/install/)、[首次运行](https://ohmygame.ai/docs/first-run/)、[模型](https://ohmygame.ai/docs/models/)和[插件](https://ohmygame.ai/docs/plugins/)。 技术文档在本仓库的 [`docs/`](docs/README.md) 下，比如[运行时](docs/runtime.md)、[编程 Agent](docs/coding-agents.md)、[自定义模型](docs/custom-models.md)和[插件规范](docs/plugins.md)。 ## 从源码构建 需要 [Bun](https://bun.sh) 1.4.2+ 和 Node.js 22.19+。 ```bash git clone https://github.com/WhiteTowerAI/ohmygame.git cd ohmygame bun install --frozen-lockfile bun run dev # 网页渲染端 + 本地守护进程 bun run dev:desktop # 或者 Electron 桌面应用 ``` 从源码构建的版本不发送任何遥测数据。分支、检查和可选的云端配置见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)。 ## 隐私 你的项目和 API 密钥都留在本机，提示词直接发给你选择的服务商。只有发布游戏时才需要账号。正式版会发送使用数据和崩溃报告，可以在 **设置 → 关于** 中关闭。见[日志与诊断](docs/diagnostics.md)。 ## 参与贡献 欢迎提 Issue 和 PR。从 `dev` 拉分支，PR 也提到 `dev`；`main` 只用于发版。先读 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)，可以从 [`help wanted`](https://github.com/WhiteTowerAI/ohmygame/labels/help%20wanted) 的 Issue 入手。安全问题请按 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) 私下报告。 ## 社区 [Discord](https://discord.gg/TkrgvGQ2Zc) · [QQ 群 460706923](https://qun.qq.com/universal-share/share?ac=1&authKey=65LzSf96ttluVSAPzPKJvrsoQ0NSQHPJnhgJImnnqIik9uK64ljVd%2FzkRWb8Xanz&busi_data=eyJncm91cENvZGUiOiI0NjA3MDY5MjMiLCJ0b2tlbiI6InNUNWR3U05OeVlMZEVCK0YxNUNKckplazliYklGRnV6ZUZGM1NlV29vYVdKNGkrR2g2c28zNG1kdDFFcHllczMiLCJ1aW4iOiIyNDUxMjQwODEifQ%3D%3D&data=CQ5T4W2Ac1NWWg56dH_HQwixT7faVMm5Xq5kZsLgx9TDBGxeqs3mwXNLVUpO83oOUobc1qXBosRKYmWnziWboA&svctype=4&tempid=h5_group_info) · [Issues](https://github.com/WhiteTowerAI/ohmygame/issues) ## Star 历史 ## 许可证 [Apache-2.0](LICENSE)。OhMyGame 的名称和标志不在许可证授权范围内。
